BiblicalUsage: Joshua or Jehoshua = "Jehovah is salvation"; n pr m; 1) son of Nun of the tribe of Ephraim and successor to Moses as the leader of the children of Israel; led the conquest of Canaan; 2) a resident of Beth-shemesh on whose land the Ark of the Covenant came to a stop after the Philistines returned it; 3) son of Jehozadak and high priest after the restoration; 4) governor of Jerusalem under king Josiah who gave his name to a gate of the city of Jerusalem
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
